messages:
mira: noticed p95 > p99 on the latency breakdown for /api/chat in the mobile cohort. tiny sample (n=14).
jin: can you paste the query?
mira: `select percentile(0.95, duration_ms), percentile(0.99, duration_ms), count(*) from requests where endpoint='/api/chat' and client='mobile' and time >= now() - interval '30 minutes'`
kai: small-n + tdigest merges often cause inversion. telemetry changed tdigest compression recently, right?
telemetry-bot: note: tdigest compression changed from 100->60 on 2026-02-09 for shard group B; headers not yet emitted to console.
jin: two quick actions: telemetry should add rollup headers (compression, rollup_variant, sample_count) and console should gray-out percentiles when sample_count < 50 with a "Inspect raw samples" link.
mira: +1. Also let's add retry_ratio to rollup metadata; retries can inflate tails.
kai: agree. I'll file telemetry#789 to emit headers + retry_ratio and console#790 for the low-sample warning and inspector. I'll mock the tooltip copy: "Low sample (n<50) - percentiles may be unreliable. Click to inspect raw events."
jin: for SLO tiles we should keep using a stable rollup_variant once telemetry provides it. product asked to avoid surprise SLO flips.
mira: ok thanks. will follow up after tickets land and re-check the slice. end of thread.
